headings.usage: Use for primary page titles, panel headers, and large metric numbers. Keep tracking tight (tracking-tight).

body.usage: Use for all general UI text, paragraphs, and standard labels.

monospace.usage: CRITICAL for EAROS: Use for AI reasoning chain logs, confidence scores, policy violation IDs, and system timestamps.

visual_enhancers.elevation: DO NOT use shadows (shadow-none). Express depth through brightness: bg-slate-950 (base) -> bg-slate-900 (panel) -> bg-slate-800 (active item). Use 1px solid borders.
visual_enhancers.borders: Expose the grid. Use border-collapse style layouts with sharp 1px borders (border-slate-800). Corner radius should be minimal: rounded-sm or rounded-md.
visual_enhancers.active_states: Use the 'Tracing Beam' concept for active AI Reasoning Cards (a glowing left-border or top-border in indigo-500 to denote active machine thinking).

layouts.strategy: MODE B: High Density Grid (Palantir/Bloomberg Terminal Vibe)
layouts.structure: Progressive Disclosure. Use dual-pane (Master-Detail) layouts for candidate pipelines and policy explorers.
layouts.spacing: Compact. Overriding general wide spacing for this specific OS context: Use p-3, p-4, and gap-4 to maximize data density.

components.sidebar: w-14 collapsed or w-64 expanded. Darkest background (bg-slate-950), right border (border-slate-800).
components.metric_strips: Top row of dashboards should be a grid of 4-6 KPIs (col-span-1 each) showing dense trend lines.

components.ai_decision_card: MUST include 4 zones: 1. Recommendation (Heading), 2. Confidence Score (Large Monospace), 3. Reasoning Chain (Steps), 4. Policy References (Tags).
components.tables: Dense. py-2 px-3 cells. Hover state must highlight the entire row (hover:bg-slate-800/50).
components.badges: Square or slightly rounded (rounded-sm). Monospace text. e.g., AI_GOVERNED

motion.transitions: Instant or very fast (150ms). This is a deterministic OS, not a consumer app. It must feel instantaneous.
motion.ai_processing: Use subtle pulsing opacity or ASCII loaders for AI generation states.

icons_and_media.icon_library: lucide-react (Use stroke-width 1.5 for a crisp, technical look)

accessibility.contrast: Ensure all text, especially secondary muted text, passes WCAG AA. Use text-slate-400 on slate-900 minimum.
accessibility.focus: All interactive elements must have focus:ring-1 focus:ring-indigo-500 focus:outline-none.

data_visualization.theme: Dark mode strictly. Use indigo, emerald, rose, amber lines. No fill areas unless opacity is <10%. Disable cartesian grid lines or make them border-slate-800/30. Use custom HTML tooltips with Monospace font.

UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: You are building an ENTERPRISE AI OPERATING SYSTEM, not a standard SaaS template. It must feel like a cross between Palantir Foundry and a Bloomberg Terminal.
Strictly apply DARK THEME. Do not use white backgrounds for main content areas.
NEVER use generic placeholder texts. Use the provided image URLs.
DO NOT apply universal transition (transition: all). Use specific properties.
DO NOT center align the app container. This is a dashboard, everything aligns top-left, utilizing 100% width and height.
Enforce visual density. Use compact padding (p-3, p-4) and sharp borders. Rely on borders instead of shadows to express elevation.
For all AI recommendations, clearly separate the 'Intelligence' (blue/indigo, monospace reasoning, confidence scores) from the 'Human Execution' (buttons to approve/execute).
All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a data-testid attribute in kebab-case.

instructions_to_main_agent.1: Initialize a React app with Tailwind CSS and Shadcn UI. Apply dark mode by default.
instructions_to_main_agent.2: Create a unified App layout with a left sidebar (Navigation) and a top header (User context, World State dropdown).
instructions_to_main_agent.3: Build the 'Recruiter Copilot' route: Split screen with candidate pipeline (left) and AI Decision/Reasoning pane (right).
instructions_to_main_agent.4: Build the 'Hiring Dashboard' route: Dense grid of KPIs, Pipeline Health, and Policy Violation logs.
instructions_to_main_agent.5: Implement the 'AI Decision Card' component as a reusable block displaying: Action, Confidence, Evidence, Reasoning Chain, and Policy Reference.
instructions_to_main_agent.6: Use Lucide React for iconography. Maintain a stroke width of 1.5 for a technical look.
